objective: Wire make_audit_consumer to a Bus at topic 'audit' and write tests/test_audit_e2e.py covering gates E1-E4 (transfer publishes and the row lands via the bus; a raising audit subscriber still yields {'ok': True} with the transactions row written; redelivering the same published event yields exactly one row; bad amount publishes nothing and writes nothing), then run the full unittest suite green and record acceptance evidence for A1-A4.

concepts: failure scenarios: raising subscriber, redelivery, bad amount
final acceptance: full unittest suite green + A1-A4 evidence recorded

inputs: T01 output: the publish path in handle_transfer (ledger/api.py)
T02 output: the consumer (ledger/worker.py) and its bus-level tests as a pattern

allowed_dependencies.what: publish path + isolation behavior to exercise
consumer under test + bus-level test patterns
consistency report as a pre-gate input

non_goals: re-designing the T01/T02 modules: integration-only patches for seam defects (topic name, field names, dedup key), each recorded as a deviation in the checkpoint
rewriting the other leaves' test files
implementation_constraints: each gate E1-E4 is a separate test method in TestAuditE2E
integration-only fix rights: T01/T02 modules may be patched for seam defects only, never for feature work

deliverables.what: E2E gate module E1-E4 with bus wiring
A1-A4 acceptance evidence (commands + outcomes) and final full-suite result

acceptance_tests.description: wiring the consumer to the bus, a successful transfer writes exactly 1 audit row via the consumer (keys equal AUDIT_EVENT_FIELDS) and exactly 1 transactions row; the response is {'ok': True}
a raising audit subscriber leaves the response {'ok': True}, no exception escapes handle_transfer, the transactions row is written, and 0 audit rows exist
redelivering the same published event on 'audit' yields exactly 1 audit row; the second consume returns {'ok': True, 'deduped': True}
bad amount returns {'ok': False, 'error': 'bad-amount'} with 0 events on the bus, 0 transactions rows, and 0 audit rows
full suite: every test in the repo passes — existing tests plus all new modules — with 0 failures and 0 errors (merged final_acceptance)
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v -> OK (test passes): 0 failures, 0 errors (all test suites green)

failure_cases.scenario: E1 fails on a field-name or topic mismatch between the publisher and the consumer (a seam defect inside T01 or T02)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: T04 applies an integration-only patch to the offending module, records the deviation in the checkpoint, and re-runs E1; it never rewrites the module's feature logic

failure_cases.scenario: a leaf's own unit test fails during the full-suite run
failure_cases.expected_behavior: record the failing test and its owner leaf in the checkpoint and stop the branch (local recoverability) — do not fix it inside T04 beyond a seam defect

handoff.notes: Terminal task: its checkpoint carries A1-A4 evidence plus the final full-suite result; on green, the Stage acceptance is met.

warnings.detail: consumes all four frozen contracts C1-C4
warnings.rationale: the E2E module drives every seam; kept as one leaf because the gates share one bus wiring — splitting would re-wire the bus per gate and re-load the same four modules

warnings.detail: p80 (90-120 min) exceeds the Stage leaf_p80_max (90 min)
warnings.rationale: four gates plus a full-suite run in one leaf; if execution exceeds p80, checkpoint_and_split around the failure-scenario gates (E2, E3)
